description: List verified manufacturers published on Gemalli. Returns each producer's name, country, certifications and profile identifier in the requested language, newest first. USE THIS whenever the question is about COMPANIES rather than goods: "who makes X", "which factories/producers/suppliers are on the platform", "show me manufacturers from <country>". A question about companies stays this tool even when it names a product — search_products returns goods, not the companies behind them. To find a specific product or filter goods by country, use search_products.

locale.description: Preferred locale for returned text. Defaults to "en".

name: list_manufacturers
title: Browse producers
